arxiv-2111-07553.title: Quantum Phase Recognition via Quantum Kernel Methods
arxiv-2111-07553.creator: Yusen Wu, Bujiao Wu, Jingbo B. Wang, Xiao Yuan
arxiv-2111-07553.description: Abstract The application of quantum computation to accelerate machine learning algorithms is one of the most promising areas of research in quantum algorithms. In this paper, we explore the power of quantum learning algorithms in solving an important class of Quantum Phase Recognition (QPR) problems, which are crucially important in understanding many-particle quantum systems.

arxiv-2201-05458.title: Localization and multifractal properties of the long-range Kitaev chain in the presence of an Aubry-André-Harper modulation
arxiv-2201-05458.creator: Joana Fraxanet, Utso Bhattacharya, Tobias Grass, Maciej Lewenstein, Alexandre Dauphin
arxiv-2201-05458.description: Abstract In the presence of quasi-periodic potentials, the celebrated Kitaev chain presents an intriguing phase diagram with ergodic, localized and and multifractal states. In this work, we generalize these results by studying the localization properties of the Aubry-André-Harper model in the presence of long-range hopping and superconducting pairing amplitudes.

arxiv-2205-09238.title: Linear prediction of point process times and marks
arxiv-2205-09238.description: Abstract In this paper, we are interested in linear prediction of a particular kind of stochastic process, namely a marked temporal point process. The observations are event times recorded on the real line, with marks attached to each event. We show that in this case, linear prediction extends straightforwardly from the theory of prediction for stationary stochastic processes.

arxiv-2205-10786.title: KMS states of quasi-free dynamics on C ∗ C^{*} -algebras of product systems over right LCM monoids Thanks: M. Laca (ORCiD: 0000-0002-0901-8165).
arxiv-2205-10786.creator: Luca Eva Gazdag, Marcelo Laca, Nadia S. Larsen
arxiv-2205-10786.description: Abstract . We generalise recent results of Afsar, Larsen and Neshveyev for product systems over quasi-lattice orders by showing that the equilibrium states of quasi-free dynamics on the Nica-Toeplitz C ∗ C^{*} -algebras of product systems over right LCM monoids must satisfy a positivity condition encoded in a system of inequalities satisfied by their restrictions to the coefficient algebra.

arxiv-2206-14734.title: LOFAR discovery of rare large FR-I jets in low-luminosity radio galaxy NGC 5322
arxiv-2206-14734.creator: Amitesh Omar
arxiv-2206-14734.description: Abstract The discovery of faint FR I radio jets in the nearby elliptical galaxy NGC 5322 is reported here using 144 MHz LOFAR image. The jets have an angular extent of ∼ 40 \sim 40 arcmin or a projected physical extent of ∼ 350 \sim 350 kpc.

arxiv-2301-04157.creator: Kristen. B. W. McQuinn, Yao-Yuan Mao, Matthew R. Buckley, David Shih, Roger E. Cohen, Andrew E. Dolphin
arxiv-2301-04157.description: Abstract We report the discovery of an ultrafaint dwarf (UFD) galaxy, Pegasus W, located on the far side of the Milky Way-M31 system and outside the virial radius of M31. The distance to the galaxy is 915 − 91 + 60 {}^{+60}_{-91} kpc, measured using the luminosity of horizontal branch (HB) stars identified in Hubble Space Telescope optical imaging.

arxiv-2401-06480.creator: R. Gueroult \aff 1 \corresp, S. K. P. Tripathi \aff 2, F. Gaboriau \aff 1, T. R. Look \aff 2, N. J. Fisch \aff 3
arxiv-2401-06480.description: Abstract We perform experiments in the Large Plasma Device (LAPD) at the University of California, Los Angeles, studying how different end-electrode biasing schemes modify the radial potential profile in the machine. We impose biasing profiles of different polarities and gradient signs on a set of five concentric electrodes placed 12 12 m downstream from the plasma source.

arxiv-2410-07243.title: Reformulation of Classical Thermodynamics from Information Theory
arxiv-2410-07243.creator: F. Barzi ID ​​, K. Fethi​​
arxiv-2410-07243.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by F. Barzi ID ​​, K. Fethi​​. In this study, we present a reformulation of classical equilibrium thermodynamics by replacing the obscure and ambiguous concept of entropy with the clear and intuitive concept of information stored in a thermodynamic system. Specifically, we rewrite the laws of thermodynamics in the mathematical terminology borrowed from information theory with an emphasis on information instead of entropy and on binary logarithm instead of natural one.

arxiv-2501-06904.title: From Simulation to Field: Learning Terrain Traversability for Real-World Deployment
arxiv-2501-06904.creator: Fetullah Atas, Grzegorz Cielniak, Lars Grimstad
arxiv-2501-06904.description: Abstract The challenge of traversability estimation is a crucial aspect of autonomous navigation in unstructured outdoor environments such as forests. It involves determining whether certain areas are passable or risky for robots, taking into account factors like terrain irregularities, slopes, and potential obstacles.

arxiv-2511-22387.title: Are Large Random Graphs Always Safe to Hide?
arxiv-2511-22387.creator: Sourav Chakraborty, Sujata Ghosh, Smiha Samanta
arxiv-2511-22387.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Sourav Chakraborty, Sujata Ghosh, Smiha Samanta. We discuss winning possibilities of players in various variants of cops and robber game played on large random graphs, a testbed for various kinds of network queries, search problems in particular. We explore the use of logic frameworks to investigate such results; in particular, we show that whenever a winning condition for either player can be expressed as a certain kind of formula in first-order logic, that player almost always wins.

pmc-11378758.creator: Anna-Maria Gierke, Martin Hessling
pmc-11378758.description: Background:The World Health Organization has published a list of pathogenic fungi with prior-itizing groups and calls for research and development of antifungal measures, with Candida auris belonging to the group with high priority.Methods:The photosensitivity towards short wavelength ultraviolet irradiation (Far-UVC, UVC, and UVB) was investigated and compared to other yeasts (Saccharomyces cerevisiae) and a mold (Cladosporium cladosporioides).

pmc-11612537.title: Differences in Tri‐Trophic Community Responses to Temperature‐Dependent Vital Rates, Thermal Niche Mismatches and Temperature‐Size Rule
pmc-11612537.creator: Samuel Dijoux, Aslak Smalås, Raul Primicerio, David S. Boukal
pmc-11612537.description: Warming climate impacts aquatic ectotherms by changes in individual vital rates and declines in body size, a phenomenon known as the temperature‐size rule (TSR), and indirectly through altered species interactions and environmental feedbacks. The relative importance of these effects in shaping community responses to environmental change is incompletely understood.

pmc-12571055.creator: Yijing Chen, Men Xia, Jinghui Zhang, Epameinondas Tsiligiannis, Cheng Wu, Chao Yan, Runlong Cai, Guangjie Zheng, Yuyang Li, Junchen Guo, Zhaojin An, Yiran Li, Xinyan Zhao, Qipeng Qu, Chenjie Hua, Zongcheng Wang, Shuxiao Wang, Yongchun Liu, Lina Cao, Kebin He, Markku Kulmala, Mattias Hallquist, Tao W
pmc-12571055.description: Chlorine radicals (Cl·) profoundly affect atmospheric oxidation capacity. Chloramines, especially trichloramine, are emerging precursors of Cl·. However, their sources and roles in the atmosphere remain elusive. This study presents field evidence of primary emissions and explicit secondary production pathways of atmospheric trichloramine in Beijing, supplemented by observations from New Delhi and reanalysis of measurements in Toronto.

pmc-13126627.description: Blending two ionic liquids (ILs) offers a promising route to discover superior solvents by combining complementary molecular features of each IL to achieve tailored thermophysical properties of mixed solvents. However, an exhaustive exploration of the vast combinatorial and compositional design space of IL–IL pairs through experiments or high-fidelity simulations is prohibitively time-consuming.

pmc-13133764.title: An ARVC-5 Drosophila knock-in model reveals new functions of Tmem43 in lipid homeostasis
pmc-13133764.creator: Kai Jürgens, Lena Menzel, Nora Klinke, Lisa Schäper, Sandra Ratnavadivel, Stefan Walter, Hendrik Milting, Heiko Meyer, Achim Paululat
pmc-13133764.description: Arrhythmogenic right ventricular cardiomyopathy type 5 is caused by the missense mutation S358L in the gene TMEM43 in humans. To date, the molecular mechanisms underlying the disease remain poorly understood. We established a CRISPR/Cas9 knock-in Drosophila model carrying the orthologous Tmem43p.S333L mutation to investigate these mechanisms in vivo.

pmc-13500748.title: 人工智能与类器官技术在胃肠间质瘤精准诊疗中的应用现状与挑战
pmc-13500748.creator: Junzhao YOU, Hongtao TANG, Shun JIANG, Zhengchao QUAN, Yimou ZHANG, Nengyi HOU, Chuan ZHOU, Minghui PANG, 柳 宋
pmc-13500748.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). 胃肠间质瘤(gastrointestinal stromal tumor，GIST)是胃肠道常见的间叶源性肿瘤，目前的诊疗方式以手术切除和靶向药物治疗为主。临床早期诊断和靶向药物的耐药是目前难以解决的问题，严重制约患者的预后。类器官技术可在体外保留患者个体的基因型与药物敏感性特征，为药物筛选和耐药机制研究提供了新平台，但其在GIST研究领域中的应用仍处于起步阶段。以人工智能(artificial intelligence，AI)为基础的影像组学、病理组学及大语言模型和智能体已在GIST患者的风险分层、基因型预测、疗效评估及全生命周期管理中展现出重要潜力。利用AI手段，将类器官模型数据与多模态临床数据融合，并推动个体化决策系统发展，是GIST精准诊疗的前沿发展方向。GIST类器官模型的构建尚处于个案报道阶段，培养成功率低且药敏试验检测周期长，难以满足临床即时决策需求。相比之下，AI在GIST影像风险分层与病理基因预测中已初步展现出较高效能，但多数模型仍缺乏多中心外部验证，泛化能力尚不明确。当前在二者融合的形态量化评估与虚拟药物筛选在技术层面仅有泛癌种的方法学借鉴，GIST领域尚缺乏直接研究；而多模态决策支持系统的构建也面临数据孤岛、算法可解释性不足及监管路径缺失等核心瓶颈。因此，未来亟需依托多中心协作建立标准化数据库，并通过真实世界研究验证融合平台的临床效用，方能推动其从概念走向实践。Keywords: 胃肠间质瘤, 人工智能, 类器官, 药敏试验, 虚拟筛选, 多模态数据融合 胃肠间质瘤(gastrointestinal stromal tumor，GIST)是胃肠道的罕见间叶源性肿瘤，占胃肠道肿瘤的1%~2%，可发生于消化道任何部位，常见于胃(50%~60%)和小肠(30%~35%)[1]。其起源于Cajal间质细胞[2]，生物学行为从惰性到高度恶性不等[3]。自2001年伊马替尼应用于GIST治疗以来，GIST已成为实体瘤靶向治疗的经典模型[4]。然而，耐药问题、危险度分层的精准性、微小GIST的处理等仍是当前临床难点。 近年来，随着国内外指南的更新及新型靶向药物的出现，GIST诊疗正向精细化、个体化的方向发展。目前GIST病因尚不明确，且缺乏特异性一级预防措施[5]，故其诊疗重心落在二级预防的早期诊断与干预上，即借助早期影像学检查及超声内镜引导下穿刺活体组织检查(以下简称“活检”)明确病理，并对局限期肿瘤行根治性手术切除；三级预防则侧重于术后对中高危患者辅以伊马替尼辅助治疗，对晚期或转移性患者施以靶向治疗，以预防复发、控制病情并延长生存期。与此同时，人工智能(artificial intelligence，AI)技术在医学图像分析、基因组学解读及临床决策支持中的应用日益成熟[6-8]。AI在GIST诊疗中正由探索迈向精准化：借助深度学习技术可辅助影像诊断、预测恶性潜能[9]及鉴别黏膜下肿瘤[10]，并能评估术后复发风险及KIT原癌基因受体酪氨酸激酶(KIT proto-oncogene, receptor tyrosine kinase，KIT)/血小板源性生长因子受体α(platelet-derived growth factor receptor alpha，PDGFRA)突变状态[11]；同时，整合临床、影像与病理的多模态模型在预测无复发生存期方面也更具优势[12]。AI为提高GIST诊断准确性、优化治疗方案提供了新思路。类器官技术作为精准医学的有力工具，在消化道肿瘤领域发展迅速，其可在体外模拟肿瘤特性，用于药物筛选、耐药机制研究及个体化治疗方案的优化[13]。然而，其在GIST中的应用仍十分有限，目前国内文献[14]仅初步报道了1例GIST类器官模型的构建。类器官在GIST中的发展尚处于起步探索阶段，面临肿瘤微环境构建、标准化培养及大规模验证等诸多挑战[15]。当前虽已有研究[16]将AI与类器官模型相结合，但尚缺乏能同时整合传统模型与类器官数据的研究。本文系统综述GIST的临床与分子基础、类器官及AI技术的应用进展，并重点探讨二者融合发展的前景与挑战。 GIST的临床与分子基础 流行病学特征 全球范围内GIST年龄标准化年发病率为 10/100万~15/100万[17]，中国地区的发病率存在地域差异，随着内镜筛查普及与病理诊断水平提升，整体检出率呈逐年上升趋势。GIST以中老年发病为主要特征，中位确诊年龄为60~65岁，发病高峰集中于50~70岁，40岁以下患者占比不足10%，儿童与青少年型GIST极为罕见且多与遗传综合征相关[5, 18]。性别分布上，多数研究[19-20]显示男性略多于女性，男女比例约1.1꞉1.0，性别差异无统计学意义[21]。原发部位以胃最为常见，占比为50%~60%，小肠占30%~35%，结直肠占5%~10%，食管不足5%，少数可原发于网膜、肠系膜及腹膜后等胃肠道外部位[22-23]。GIST的临床表现缺乏特异性，其症状与肿瘤的大小、原发部位、生长方式及是否发生并发症密切相关[24]。早期GIST起病隐匿，通常不引起任何自觉症状，这使其难以被及时察觉，多数患者是在行胃镜、结肠镜或腹部影像学检查(CT、超声)时偶然发现的。其流行病学特征与诊断技术、地区医疗水平及人群筛查策略密切相关，为临床早诊、早治与人群防控提供重要依据。如何早期筛选高危人群并发现可疑病灶仍是目前无法突破的难题。 分子发病机制 GIST的发生和发展主要依赖于KIT或PDGFRA基因的功能获得性突变。70%~80%的GIST存在KIT基因突变(主要发生于11号外显子，其次为9、13、17号外显子)，10%~15%存在PDGFRA基因突变，这些突变导致酪氨酸激酶受体持续性激活，下游信号通路异常活化，驱动肿瘤细胞增殖[25]。 缺乏KIT/PDGFRA突变的GIST既往被称为“野生型”，但实际上这一群体存在显著的分子异质性，包括琥珀酸脱氢酶(succinate dehydrogenase，SDH)缺陷型、B-raf原癌基因丝氨酸/苏氨酸激酶(B-raf proto-oncogene, serine/threonine kinase，BRAF)突变型、1型神经纤维瘤病(neurofibromatosis type 1，NF1)突变型、大鼠肉瘤病毒癌基因同源物(rat sarcoma viral oncogene homolog，RAS)突变型及神经营养因子酪氨酸受体激酶(neurotrophic tyrosine receptor kinase，NTRK)融合型等。这些野生型GIST的发病机制主要涉及非KIT/PDGFRA通路的异常激活：SDH缺陷导致琥珀酸堆积，抑制脯氨酰羟化酶而稳定缺氧诱导因子1α(hypoxia-inducible factor 1 alpha，HIF-1α)，从而激活假性缺氧信号[26]；BRAF、RAS或NF1突变则直接驱动下游丝裂原活化蛋白激酶(mitogen-activated protein kinase，MAPK)通路持续活化[27]。SDH缺陷型GIST可发生于Carney三联征(GIST、副神经节瘤、肺软骨瘤)或Carney-Stratakis综合征(GIST合并副神经节瘤)的背景下，也可为散发，其临床特征包括年轻发病、胃原发、多中心生长和惰性病程[25]。 遗传综合征相关性GIST 尽管绝大多数GIST为散发性，但3%~5%的GIST与遗传综合征相关，其发病机制涉及特定基因的胚系突变。根据遗传基础的不同，这类综合征主要可分为KIT/PDGFRA胚系突变相关家族性GIST综合征、NF1相关GIST及SDH缺陷相关综合征[28]。家族性GIST综合征多由KIT基因11号外显子胚系突变所致，除多发性GIST外，常伴皮肤色素沉着[29-30]；PDGFRA胚系突变者则无皮肤表现[31]。NF1相关GIST由NF1失活导致RAS通路激活，肿瘤多位于小肠且对伊马替尼不敏感[32]。SDH缺陷相关GIST(包括Carney-Stratakis综合征及Carney三联征)呈胃原发、上皮样形态，免疫组织化学(以下简称“免疫组化”)显示SDHB表达缺失[33-34]。该类综合征具有发病年龄早、多中心性特点，且不同亚型对靶向治疗反应差异显著，精准分型对治疗决策至关重要。 传统诊断方法与治疗手段 GIST临床表现缺乏特异性，早期常无症状。CT是首选影像学方法，磁共振成像(magnetic resonance imaging，MRI)对直肠GIST和肝转移评估具有独特价值，超声内镜(endoscopic ultrasonography，EUS)有助于小GIST诊断及引导活检[24, 35-41]。病理确诊依赖CD117和DOG1免疫组化，分子检测指导靶向治疗。危险度分层采用美国武装力量病理研究所(Armed Forces Institute of Pathology，AFIP)标准[42](基于肿瘤部位、大小、核分裂象)和改进版美国国立卫生研究院(National Institutes of Health，NIH)标准[43]。 手术切除是局限性GIST的首选治疗方式，原则为完整切除(R0)且避免肿瘤破裂。无需常规淋巴结清扫[44-45]。靶向治疗方面，伊马替尼为一线标准，舒尼替尼、瑞戈非尼、瑞派替尼分别用于二、三、四线，阿伐替尼对PDGFRA D842V突变高效[46-47]。新辅助治疗适用于局部晚期患者，可提高R0切除率。 传统影像学诊断 CT检查是目前GIST首选的影像学评估手段，可用于定位诊断、分期、可切除性评估及疗效监测。典型GIST在CT上表现为边界清晰的富血供肿块，可有坏死、囊变或出血，增强扫描呈不均匀强化[35]。但传统CT在鉴别GIST与其他黏膜下肿瘤、判断恶性潜能方面存在一定局限[36-37]。 MRI在GIST的精准诊疗中具有不可替代的独特价值。凭借其卓越的软组织对比度与多平面成像能力，MRI对肝转移灶的检出敏感度优于增强CT，是直肠GIST局部分期与术前评估的最佳影像学手段。对于碘对比剂过敏或需减少辐射暴露的年轻患者，MRI是CT的重要替代选择。近年来，基于基线多参数MRI的影像组学模型[38]在预测转移性GIST患者靶向治疗反应及6个月疾病进展方面展现出良好潜力[曲线下面积(area under the curve，AUC)达0.847~0.974]，为早期危险分层提供了新工具，但值得注意的是该模型尚不能替代已建立的临床评估流程，仍需后续不断更新优化。 EUS对于胃和小GIST的诊断具有独特价值，可清晰显示肿瘤起源层次—固有肌层、边界、内部回声及血流信号，并可引导细针穿刺活检[15]。Huh等[40]的研究显示，EUS对GIST的诊断准确率约为74.6%，与CT在该队列中的诊断效能(准确率约为78.9%)大致相当。 超声造影是近年来发展的新技术，通过口服胃窗超声造影剂充盈胃腔，可清晰显示胃壁层次结构和肿瘤形态特征。Wang等[41]基于121例原发性胃GIST的研究显示，通过ResNet深度学习模型分析超声造影图像，预测GIST危险分层的AUC可达0.896。该方法无创、无辐射、耐受性好，有望成为GIST早期筛查和随访的补充手段。 影像组学通过从医学图像中高通量提取定量特征，结合机器学习构建预测模型，已在GIST的鉴别诊断、基因分型预测和预后评估中展现出应用前景。有多项研究[48-49]尝试通过影像学特征无创预测KIT/PDGFRA突变状态，为指导靶向治疗提供参考。利用影像组学、机器学习等先进技术分析相关影像，已成为GIST领域的研究热点。这些方法有望作为靶向治疗前的一种非侵入性、可靠的辅助评估手段，对筛选需要优先进行基因检测的高危患者或为无法获取足够活检组织的晚期患者提供参考均具有重要意义。 传统病理学诊断 GIST的确诊依赖于病理学检查。典型GIST在光镜下呈梭形细胞型(70%)、上皮样细胞型(20%)或混合型(10%)。免疫组化检测中，CD117(KIT蛋白)和DOG1是敏感度和特异度最高的标志物，约95%的GIST呈CD117阳性，DOG1阳性率与之相当[44]。约5%的GIST可表现为CD117阴性，此时DOG1检测具有重要补充价值。 分子检测在GIST诊疗中的地位日益重要。推荐对所有拟接受靶向治疗的中高危GIST患者进行KIT/PDGFRA突变检测，以指导药物选择和剂量决策。对于KIT/PDGFRA野生型GIST，应进一步进行免疫组化检测SDHB表达，如表达缺失则提示SDH缺陷型，需行SDHx基因检测；如SDHB表达保留，则应检测BRAF、RAS、NF1及NTRK融合等。分子检测应在通过外部质量保证认证的中心实验室进行，以确保结果可靠性。 危险度分层是GIST预后评估和辅助治疗决策的基础。目前应用最广的是AFIP标准[42](基于肿瘤部位、大小、核分裂象)和改进版美国NIH标准[43](纳入肿瘤部位和非破裂性破裂因素)。核分裂象计数应统一以5 mm2为单位进行报告，以保证可比性。 类器官技术及其在GIST中的探索 类器官技术是通过三维培养系统将患者来源的肿瘤组织在体外扩增为微型器官样结构，能够高度保留原始肿瘤的基因型、组织学特性和药物反应异质性[50]。类器官培养技术的首次成功建立开启了癌症研究的新纪元，为研究者及临床医师提供了观察肿瘤生物学特征、发掘新型生物标志物及优化个性化治疗策略的重要工具。来源于外科手术标本或肿瘤活检组织的类器官，可通过药物敏感性检测及半数抑制浓度(half
